scope: Result-informed development diagnostic of existing target-owned UV support. Locate correspondence and conservative-mask effects; do not modify masks, synthesize unknown texture or tune detection.

observations.focus_selection: 004a63 has four failed targets and a historical complete ocular exclusion band; 082a27 and 006a55 are predeclared successful-frontal comparators. This is not independent validation.

cohort.source_labels: Filename ages are research labels only; requested target ages remain conditions.

reconstruction.raw_fit: Use pinned saved target vertices/projection/ROI plus native ordered triangles and keypoint_coordinates; no model loading or fitting. Bind all metadata to N0, N4 and the generated fit report.
reconstruction.uv: Read original float32 common uv, cast to float64, then flip v=1-v before uv_texture._uv_samples at atlas size256. Compare its float32 output to saved gltf_uv; do not rasterize the quantized saved gltf_uv as the primary input.
reconstruction.projection: Use target own project_vertices(raw) and target own ROI; interpolate projected native target triangles with UV barycentric weights. Recompute front/in-image/continuous max-Z visibility and all-nonzero-contributor allowed-mask test exactly, and require all seven classifications to equal the saved map.
reconstruction.topology: Verify ordered native triangles/keypoint-coordinate topology hash, vertex order and common UV binding. Use native face order for owner/bary; the GLB winding reversal is not silently applied.
reconstruction.landmarks: Use target fitted 68 XY computed with the saved 68x3 coordinate indices; allow maximum absolute XY residual0.001 pixel against saved projected_landmarks. Sparse and dense Z have separate min shifts; never compare those Z values or infer landmark UV by dividing coordinate indices by3.
reconstruction.source_canonical: Interpolate the original source vertices using the same native face owner/bary, then use the original N4 source_center and uniform scale. Verify source bbox frame from the pinned original source fit. Never renormalize each target or rotate its output by its camera.
reconstruction.saved_samples: Require exact rgba/classification/coverage/gltf_uv arrays; unknown RGBA stays zero, alpha matches coverage and classification sampled. No new texture or GLB is produced.

regional_counting.definition: For each region use the target fitted landmark XY min/max box, expanded by0.25 of that box width/height on each respective side. Require positive finite width/height; no image clipping or arbitrary default size. Membership uses half-open [xmin,xmax),[ymin,ymax).
regional_counting.requested: All unambiguous owned UV texel centers whose continuous target XY lies in the region, including back-facing/outside-image/self-occluded points; report mutually exclusive seven-class counts with sum=requested. Outside-UV and ambiguous texels have no unique region correspondence and remain separately counted globally.
regional_counting.overlap: Four regions may overlap; do not sum them as a disjoint face partition. Also report all_unique_correspondence as a whole-face control.
regional_counting.support: sampled/requested when requested>0, otherwise null. Unknown and rejected counts remain explicit; fitted boxes are diagnostic proxies, not anatomical ground truth.
regional_counting.mask_rejection: For visible mask_rejected samples inspect all nonzero-weight bilinear pixels. Partition rejected texels into reviewed_occluder_only, other_ineligible_only, mixed_contributors. A reviewed candidate mask is not segmentation/occlusion truth; other ineligible includes conservative uncertainty, hull erosion and mouth exclusion without a precise causal label.
regional_counting.occluder_test: Any positive-weight occluded pixel is a reviewed-occluder contribution; any positive-weight pixel with not allowed and not occluded is other-ineligible. Reject allowed&occluded overlap. Zero-weight neighbors never cause rejection.

integrity.before: Freeze protocol, implementation/tests, metadata roles and all selected target/source fit, topology, commonUV, masks and saved sample/image/atlas/classification/coverage pins before regional results. Read bounded immutable verified byte snapshots before decoding; never deserialize pickle.
integrity.after: Rehash every input and loaded source after all computations and output preparation; drift prevents successful publication and invalidates affected results. Refuse overwriting prior study outputs.

outputs: Ignored report.json retains every12target request and errors plus global/5-region counts, residuals and input/runtime pins; per successful target correspondence.npz stores UV texel indices/native owner/bary/target XYZ/source canonical XYZ/region bits/rejection partition, with explicit coordinate semantics. No raw photos, crops, new atlases or GLBs are written.
success: Reconstruct target-owned correspondence, verify the exact existing classification and quantify regional support/rejection with preserved original bytes. Detection success and quality acceptance are not exit criteria.
